title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for CKD and hypertension.

HPI: (Copied Forward) Patient is a 78-year-old male who presents for ongoing management of chronic kidney disease and hypertension. He reports stable symptoms. He denies any new shortness of breath or significant edema. He reports adherence to his current medication regimen and denies any side effects.

Vitals: BP 138/84, HR 74, SpO2 98% on RA, Temp 98.6 F.

Review of Systems:
Constitutional: Negative
Respiratory: Negative
Cardiovascular: Negative
Gastrointestinal: Negative
Genitourinary: Negative
Musculoskeletal: Negative
Neurological: Negative

Medication List:
Lisinopril 10mg daily
Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5mg daily

Exam:
General: Well-appearing, alert, and oriented x3.
Cardiovascular: Regular rate and rhythm, no murmurs.
Pulmonary: Clear to auscultation bilaterally.
Renal: No flank pain, no palpable masses.
Extremities: No edema noted.

Assessment:
1. Chronic kidney disease, stage 3a. Recent labs show eGFR of 52 mL/min/1.73m2.
2. Hypertension. Blood pressure is currently stable on current medications.

Plan:
Continue current medications. Order repeat metabolic panel and eGFR in 3 months. Patient instructed to monitor blood pressure at home and report any significant changes.

Electronically signed, R. Mensah, NP, 05/12/2026
explanations: Hypertension with CKD is presumed linked: I12.9 for CKD stage 1-4 (sequenced first), plus the N18 stage code.

distractors.why: The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
I12.0 is for stage 5 or ESRD only.
Stage 3a is documented; do not use unspecified stage 3.
